leadText:
Dr. Moss (Japanese: ドクター・マスダ Dr. Masuda) is a character of the day who appeared in Delcatty Got Your Tongue. He was seen only in flashbacks and didn't have a speaking role. He is a Pokémon Doctor.

Dr. Moss was Dr. Abby's teacher in the techniques of massage therapy for Pokémon, much like . He gave Dr. Abby the Moon Stone that evolved her into a , teaching her that Abby had to "evolve" herself much like Johnny had.
